raw_text: Heavy fighting continues in the Sudanese capital Khartoum for a second day as the power struggle between the army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces intensifies. At least 56 civilians have been killed and hundreds wounded. Foreign governments are scrambling to evacuate diplomatic staff. The UN Security Council has called for an immediate ceasefire.
clean_text: Fighting continues in Khartoum between army and RSF. At least 56 civilians killed. Foreign governments evacuating staff. UN Security Council calls for ceasefire.
